violated_contract: Every persisted ERROR record for a failed sync operation must preserve the failure cause: the exception text and the original stack trace. A record whose extra payload identifies only the affected device (or other context) without the error itself is unauditable and hides recurring failure classes from support and telemetry.
canonical_prevention: At every catch site that persists a sync-failure record, capture the original stack (catch (e, st)) and include a serialized cause (e.toString()) plus the failing phase in the record payload; keep catch-and-continue behavior unchanged.
